requirements.label: GCE A-level · aggregate calculation
requirements.details: Use up to the best three eligible A-level subjects completed within two years. Grades score A* or A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1 and U=0. One A* bonus point can apply. The qualifications guide specifies exceptional AS-level combinations and does not count repeated subjects twice.
